[P3] Revisit the untested probe rejection guards

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is unmet here and in case 23's identical `probe` guard. All added test cases invoke these probes with an active SDK span; even `no-ambient` installs the SDK plugin. Removing either rejection therefore leaves the assertions unchanged, and the invalid-context failure behavior remains untested. Return to the design phase under rule 8 to decide whether these guards are required beyond the existing parentage assertions and establish the minimum necessary, demonstrably tested contract.
